fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-08-30 states that the complainant invested Rs. 12,00,000 in a scheme promising fixed monthly returns, but payouts stopped after two months, on 2025-08-28 at roughly 12:35. Durga Bai approached Chennai Central PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000388. The complainant alleged that Hariharan Palanisamy may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000463. The complaint refers to another person whose identity could not be established. The account reference SYN-ACC-100081 was noted in connection with the payment. Madhan Kumar (9000000410) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Potentially relevant material referenced includes mobile phone records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Scheme reportedly promoted through a messaging group.
fields.Keywords: investment fraud, high returns, witness, mobile number, phone records, apartment complex, receiving account, suspect
